verdict.rationale: The evidence documents only a Jules REST API with API keys and endpoints for creating sessions, sending messages and approving plans. Nothing shows official client SDKs or libraries for any language. A raw API is a developer building block, not the named SDK capability, so it earns no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: You can use the API to create custom workflows, automate tasks like bug fixing and code reviews, and embed Jules's intelligence directly into the tools you use every day
